display_long_description:
Meditation Space is a dynamic, audio-reactive VR experience where breath, sound, and visuals merge within a futuristic wireframe world.

Breathe - Design your own breathing rhythms with the intuitive algorithm builder. You have full control over inhale, exhale, and hold durations. As you breathe, the environment and inner core shift and morph in sync, creating a powerful visual connection to your breath.

Explore & Meditate - Switch between immersive, audio-responsive environments and visual themes. Enjoy silence in a serene neon landscape, or let sound shape your reality. Use built-in music, import your favorite tracks, or let the environment react to external sounds captured through the Oculus headset’s microphone.

Exercise - Go beyond meditation. Apply your custom-made patterns to movement, fitness, cardio, or other activities.

Play - Enter Game Mode, where you defend your inner core from energy-draining parasites. Lose points as they attack - and regain them by completing focused breathing challenges in the recovery phase. Balance calm and intensity as you master both stillness and action.

Please note that this app is still in development, and some features may be limited. We are continuously refining and expanding it, driven by our passion to create the most immersive and powerful experience possible. Our goal is to make this tool truly valuable and accessible to everyone who seeks to explore it.
